name: Trans & Diff Coolers
description: Gearbox and differential oil cooling: coolers, electric pumps, thermostats, filters, AN lines and fittings, pump control and ducting. ZL1 1LE has standard trans and rear diff coolers; race builds use dedicated ducted circuits.

components.name: Transmission oil cooler
components.description: Oil-to-air heat exchanger for gearbox oil. GM fits a standard transmission cooler on the ZL1 1LE; a race car with sustained full-throttle running should have one regardless of gearbox. Sequential boxes (e.g. Holinger RD6) have an internal pump with external cooler provision; an H-pattern TR-6060 needs an external electric pump.
components.location: Race placement: ducted into the right lower front fascia opening beside the radiator stack (x≈-0.60, y≈0.30, z≈-0.55). Alternative: under-floor with NACA duct.

factory.name: GM transmission cooler (ZL1 1LE standard)
factory.notes: Part of the ZL1 1LE '11 heat exchangers' cooling package (with engine oil and rear diff coolers).

raceOptions.name: Setrab ProLine STD oil cooler (10-19 row) with -8 AN ports
raceOptions.notes: Size from heat load; mount on rubber isolators with a sealed duct.

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Mount with sealed duct so all air goes through the core.
Ports at top or side to aid bleeding; protect core with mesh.

components.name: Transmission cooler pump (H-pattern box)
components.description: 12 V positive-displacement pump that draws gear oil from the TR-6060 sump and pushes it through filter, thermostat and cooler. Not needed with a sequential gearbox that has an internal pump (Holinger RD6).
components.location: Mounted low beside the transmission on the tunnel/crossmember, below oil level for self-priming (x≈0.95, y≈0.24, z≈-0.20).

factory.name: Not used on factory TR-6060 (see GM SI for ZL1 1LE cooler circuit)

raceOptions.name: Motorsport 12 V gear-oil pump
raceOptions.notes: Choose a pump rated for hot 75W-90 and continuous duty; mount on rubber isolators.

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Pump must be lower than the pickup; keep suction line short and large.
inspection: Pump current draw in PDM data

sources.title: Holinger RD6-S sequential gearbox manual (2011) - specs, torque settings, lubrication

components.name: Transmission oil thermostat / bypass
components.description: In-line thermostatic valve that bypasses the cooler until oil reaches working temperature, so the gearbox warms quickly and is not over-cooled in cold sessions.
components.location: In the cooler feed line near the cooler (x≈-0.40, y≈0.30, z≈-0.45).

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Observe flow arrows (IN from pump, OUT to cooler, BYPASS/return).

sources.title: Holinger RD6-S sequential gearbox manual (2011) - specs, torque settings, lubrication

modelRef.features: Billet thermostat/bypass block, 4 AN ports, element cap

components.name: Transmission cooler lines
components.description: Feed and return hoses between gearbox, pump, filter, thermostat and cooler. -8 AN PTFE or rubber-core braided hose, fire-sleeved near the exhaust, clamped every 300 mm.
components.location: Passenger side of tunnel from trans forward to front cooler (see routes drivetrain.route.trans-cooler-feed / -return).

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Keep ≥75 mm from exhaust or use heat sleeve.
Leave flex where the drivetrain moves relative to the body.

sources.title: Holinger RD6-S sequential gearbox manual (2011) - specs, torque settings, lubrication

modelRef.features: Cooler lines along the tunnel to the front cooler

components.name: Transmission cooler pickup / return fittings
components.description: Adapter fittings that turn gearbox ports into AN connections: pickup from the low drain-plug port, return to a high port (fill port or dedicated spray-bar boss). Sequential boxes provide dedicated cooler ports.
components.location: TR-6060 drain port (pickup, x≈0.80, y≈0.25) and fill/side port (return, x≈0.86, y≈0.38, z≈-0.14).

raceOptions.name: Plug-to-AN adapters with crush washers
raceOptions.notes: Match case thread exactly; a level-check plug must remain available.

hardware.spec: Case thread with crush washer / O-ring
hardware.torque: ≈25 ft-lb (34 N·m) - aluminum case, do not exceed plug torque

installNotes: Fit a pickup screen at the drain port.
Re-establish a level-check method (sight tube or level plug) after converting fill port.

sources.title: Holinger RD6-S sequential gearbox manual (2011) - specs, torque settings, lubrication

modelRef.features: Anodised AN adapters in the case/pickup ports

components.name: Differential oil cooler
components.description: Oil-to-air cooler for the rear axle. GM fits a standard rear differential cooler on the ZL1 1LE (lines run along the tunnel near the driveshaft - QA1 instructions have you unclip them). For a race car, mount a ducted cooler at the rear to keep lines short.
components.location: Race placement: rear, behind the bumper beam on the right with a fascia/diffuser duct (x≈3.55, y≈0.35, z≈-0.45).

factory.name: GM rear differential cooler (ZL1 1LE standard)
factory.notes: Factory cooler line routing passes along the driveshaft tunnel.

raceOptions.name: Setrab ProLine STD cooler with -10 AN ports

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Duct from a high-pressure area; exhaust air into low-pressure (diffuser) area.

components.name: Differential cooler pump
components.description: 12 V positive-displacement pump that pulls axle oil from a low pickup on the diff and pushes it through filter, thermostat and cooler back to a high return port. Usually switched by diff temperature.
components.location: On the rear cradle/floor beside the diff below oil level (x≈2.95, y≈0.28, z≈-0.25).

factory.name: GM ZL1 1LE diff cooler circuit (see GM SI)

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Mount on the sprung body or cradle with flexible lines to the diff.

components.name: Differential oil thermostat / bypass
components.description: In-line thermostatic bypass so the diff reaches working temperature (clutch-type LSDs are temperature sensitive) before the cooler is in circuit.
components.location: In feed line near diff cooler (x≈3.35, y≈0.32, z≈-0.40).

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

components.name: Differential cooler lines
components.description: -10 AN suction (pickup to pump) and -8/-10 AN pressure/return hoses between diff, pump, thermostat and cooler. Use flexible hose between the cradle-mounted diff and the body.
components.location: From diff (x≈2.9) rearward along right side of trunk floor to rear cooler (see routes).

factory.name: GM diff cooler lines (ZL1 1LE) along tunnel

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

installNotes: Keep away from exhaust and brake lines; allow for cradle movement.

components.name: Differential cooler pickup / return fittings
components.description: Pickup bung low on the diff (or drain-plug adapter) and return high on the cover so returning oil is not immediately re-picked-up. Some builders weld/tap AN bosses into an aftermarket cover.
components.location: Diff cover/housing (pickup x≈2.90, y≈0.25; return x≈2.96, y≈0.44).
installNotes: Keep return outlet away from ring-gear sling and pickup.

components.name: In-line oil filters (trans & diff circuits)
components.description: Stainless mesh or spin-on filters ahead of each cooler (after the pump) to catch wear metal before it is recirculated and to protect the cooler core. Inspecting the element is a cheap health check.
components.location: Trans circuit near pump (x≈0.80, y≈0.22, z≈-0.30); diff circuit near pump (x≈3.05, y≈0.30, z≈-0.32).

hardware.notes: Common AN practice: hand tight then 1/8-1/4 turn; do not exceed fitting maker's chart.

sources.title: Holinger RD6-S sequential gearbox manual (2011) - specs, torque settings, lubrication

modelRef.features: Billet in-line filter, hex end caps, AN ends

components.name: Cooler pump control (temp switch / PDM logic)
components.description: Switches the trans and diff cooler pumps on above a set oil temperature (with hysteresis) - either a simple threshold switch + relay or a PDM output driven by sensor values over CAN. Include a manual override for testing.
components.location: PDM output channels / relay panel (electrical system).

raceOptions.name: PDM channel logic
raceOptions.notes: e.g. ON >80°C, OFF <70°C, always ON in race mode.

installNotes: Fuse each pump per manufacturer current rating.
inspection: Pump state vs temp in data

sources.title: GM Service Bulletin 17-NA-251: 2018 Camaro ZL1 1LE New Model Features (TREMEC 6060 RPO MH3 ratios, 226 mm eLSD, coolers)

components.name: Cooler ducts & shrouds
components.description: Sealed inlet ducts and shrouds that force air through the trans (front) and diff (rear) cooler cores. Without sealing, coolers in race cars are often largely ineffective.
components.location: Front: right lower fascia opening to trans cooler. Rear: fascia/diffuser opening to diff cooler.

raceOptions.name: Aluminum or composite duct + foam seal

installNotes: Seal all gaps around the core with foam/edge trim.
